 Los Blancos, still smiling after their Camp Nou Clásico win, return to an old stadium without their Brazilian star.
 Joe Brennan twitter William Allen Calum Roche twitter Update: Nov 1st, 2026 09:00 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Vinicius Jr will miss Real Madrid’s LaLiga clash with Racing Santander on Sunday , as he serves the third game in a four-match suspension for his red card against Villarreal last month.
 On October 10, the Brazilian was sent off during Madrid’s 1-0 victory at the Bernabéu, after a VAR review revealed that he had pulled Villarreal midfielder Nathan Saliba’s hair before scoring what would have been Los Blancos’ second goal of the game.

 Which games is Vinicius missing?
 In the wake of Vinicius’s dismissal, the Spanish Football Federation’s disciplinary committee handed the 26-year-old a four-game ban , with two matches for the hair-pulling incident and another two for his reaction to the referee following his sending-off.
 Real Madrid appealed the decision, hoping to have the suspension reduced, but the challenge was rejected on October 16. Vinicius’s ban therefore covers the following LaLiga games: 
 Sunday, Oct. 18: Real Madrid 4-1 Sevilla 
 Sunday, Oct. 25: Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid 
 Sunday, Nov. 1: Racing Santander vs Real Madrid 
 Saturday, Nov. 7: Valencia vs Real Madrid 
 The suspension is the latest setback in a poor season so far for Vinicius , who has scored just one goal in 11 Madrid games and drawn jeers from unhappy Bernabéu fans.

 When will Vinicius return?
 The ban applies only to domestic competitions, meaning Vinicius remains available for Real Madrid’s Champions League fixtures during that period. Indeed, the forward started his team’s 4-1 win over RB Leipzig – before missing El Clásico triumph – as the 15-time European champions maintained their 100% start to this season’s league phase.
 Vinicius will be eligible to return to Spanish league action in Madrid’s home game against Celta Vigo on November 21 , following the international break. Before then, he can feature in Wednesday’s Champions League trip to AEK Athens. 
 Who will replace Vinicius against Racing Santander?
 In Vinicius’ LaLiga absence, summer signing Yan Diomande was given the nod on the left wing against Sevilla and impressed in Madrid’s 4-1 win, registering a goal and an assist. Having also scored one and set up another against Leipzig, as a second-half substitute for Vinicius, the Ivorian kept his place for last weekend’s 2-1 Clásico victory over Barcelona , producing another impressive display.
 Diomande is expected to start again against Racing Santander today , with José Mourinho likely to make only limited changes to his lineup despite a busy week ahead.
